transcript.text: Just like with every new region introduced in Dragon Wilds, Umbral Sands comes with a new set of vestiges to
chase. And this time around the main focus is going to be the new obsidian style gear. In this video I'm going to
quickly go over how to get the new vestiges they unlock specifically, what enemies or sources you should be
farming, and how I would personally optimize your time. On top of that, I'm also going to go over how to get a
dagger as well as an amulet and a necklace. So, six items in total that you can farm for. Now, quickly before we
get into the actual drops, there's one important thing I do want to mention. There are technically four vestiges with
Umbral Sands, the fourth one being the obsidian shield. This is technically not in the game yet. We could see it in a
creative world, but it does not seem to be properly obtainable as a normal drop. Might be bugged, it may not be in the
active drop pool yet, or it may be added in a smaller update throughout Umbral Sands. In my opinion, this will most
likely drop from the toxil golem. As of right now, the obsidian shield is currently not obtainable. The first one
is the elongated obsidian construct. This is the staff vestige. This can come from the toxil golem, the guitar cow, as
well as the guitar her. So, if you're trying to get the staff, those are the enemies you want to focus on and keep
farming and add them into your rotation. Most of these items is going to be right here in the burning spire. You have a
toxil golem here, you have one here inside this cave as long as you finish this quest. If you haven't, I have a
guide on the channel that goes over that. And you also have a toxil golem right here. Another spawn for a golem is
going to be up here in this town. As you guys see where that paw print is. So, that alone is four locations
for that. And then you're going to be farming the remaining of the enemies in this area. And this is primarily where
you're going to farm for all of these vestiges except for the necklace and amulet. Next, we're going to move on to
the shattered black blade. This is a one-handed sword. The guitar cow is one of the main sources you want to farm for
this. This is also why the guitar cow are really good enemy to include in your farming route overall because it can
potentially give you both the shattered black blade as well as the elongated obsidian construct. So again, you're
going to be farming the Burning Gyre for these. So when you're working on these weapons, you will have a chance to get
any of them as long as you're just farming in this region. Then we have the third and final Obsidian piece, which is
the Bludgeoning Obsidian Construct. This is the big blunt two-handed weapon visage, and this one is tied
specifically to the Katarkek. So if you're looking for the mall style Obsidian weapon, the Katarkek is the
enemy that will drop this, and that's the one you should be targeting. Now again, guys, you're going to be farming
mainly in the Burning Gyre. So getting these weapons to drop is not that difficult, and I will tell you guys
right now, this is very different than any farm we have ever seen in the title because Umbral Sands chests, enemies,
whether it's a world boss or standard enemies, they respawn a lot shorter than they do in other regions. As you know,
Fel Hollow, Zilgar spawn every 8 days, the Kalphite Queen and the Toxil spawn every 2 days, and these base enemies
spawn very frequently. Not even in a full day, they will respawn. Farming these is very easy to come by. If you
want to, here's a little tip for you, there is a dragon located right here, a red dragon, if you want to add that to
your farming route. I recommend you bringing anti-fire potions just to make this farm a lot easier for you. Now
there is also the Karax Dagger, which is located in the southwest vault in the chest at the end after the Kalphite
Queen. That's this vault right here underneath Manafen Plains. This one's very easy to come by. This is the simple
vault where you go through the vault with the Staff of Light, keep the bugs away from you. You do have to kill the
Kalphite Queen at the end, but once you do, there is a chest located in the room. I do want to make a point of this
chest specifically. Keep in mind, this chest is kind of broken at the end of the vault. The chest can be easy to miss
or visually bugged. You might be able to hear it, but look around the exit of the area and check the sand embankments,
specifically the embankment on the left. You actually can phase through it, and the chest is hidden underneath the sand
embankment. So if you've done this fight before, and you're like, "There is no chest, there's no reward, that's kind of
weird. It's actually currently glitched into the wall. Also, this chest could be bugged. Sometimes it doesn't open for
me. Sometimes when I open it, it is completely empty. So, this chest overall is just bugged. Keep farming. Again,
chests respawn every 3 to 4 days in this region. Now, on top of these vestiges, we're going to go over the two last gear
pieces you can get. This is going to be the amulet of glory as well as the skills necklace. Now, this is not one of
the obsidian weapon vestiges, but it is another big chase drop from Umbral Sands. And this specifically drops from
red dragons. Now, if you're looking for red dragons, there's actually plenty located around the map. There's one
located right here on the map, kind of near this entry point to the Burning Spire. There's one located here, like I
said before, so you have two here. And then if we work our way up to the northern part of the map, you actually
have one over here. You have one right here, and you have one right here. That alone gives you five farming routes for
red dragons overall. And again, these guys spawn every roughly 3 to 4 days. So, just add them to your farming route
if you want to get the amulet of glory as well as a skills necklace. Now, the amulet of glory increases your melee,
magic, and range crit damage, as well as gives you increased defense. This is a great piece of gear for Umbral Sands,
especially when you're going against mini bosses or Fuzion in general. Now, the skills necklace grants a bonus when
gathering, fishing, mining, and wood cutting resources in the world. So, this overall will just give you a bonus in
general. This is a very good necklace if you're specifically going for fishing, mining, wood cutting, whatever it may
be. It's not going to be giving you XP, but it's going to be giving you more resources and a bonus when you're
collecting items if you're wearing this. I recommend you plopping this thing on,
craft it immediately, and start using it when you're doing resource grinding. But
again, the amulet of glory is an amazing piece of gear, and for me, it honestly has replaced my unholy symbol that I
used for a very long time since doubt on reach. So, really quickly to recap, the elongated obsidian construct staff is
farmed from Toxophil Golems, K'tarr Cow, K'tarr Herr. The shattered black blade is farmed from K'tarr Cow, and the
bludgeoning obsidian construct can be farmed from the K'tarr Kat. The dagger is dropped at the end of the pyramid in
the chest. It is a guaranteed drop as long as the chest works in the southern part of the map. And the amulet of glory
as well as the skills necklace is tied to the red dragon, but keep in mind these are a 2.5 out of 100 chance for
them to drop. They are very, very low. Overall, this is a pretty solid set of chase items for Umbral Sands, and the
best way to save time is to farm wide early, especially around the K'tarr enemies and the burning spire with
overlapping drops, and then target farm the specific source once you only have one or two. That way every run has a
better chance of giving you something useful instead of locking you into one enemy and wasting your time. Another
quick tip, this is very simple, the second that your meter goes to about the 8:00 position, you can sleep. So,
immediately, immediately when that reaches about 8:00 position, go to your bed and sleep. That way the days will
progress and then all these farming sources will progress towards their reset. If you guys enjoyed this video
and it was at all insightful, please drop a like on it and subscribe for all things Dragon Wilds, everything survival
crafting. We'd love to have you in the community. If you've gotten any of these items, let me know down in the comments
below. What is your favorite item so far and what is your favorite vestige? What are you still chasing for? Appreciate
every single one of you guys and thanks for all the love and support. And as always, stay happy, stay hyped, and have
a beautiful day.
